reason: I forget my pills at home every time I travel, and a pre-counted foil sachet I can toss in my bag fixes that. $24.99 for the first box is low enough to try, and the named lab report plus the money-back guarantee make it a small risk.
objection: Two capsules every day is still a chore, and it is made in China. I only half believe the lab report matches what is really in the box until I scan the QR code myself.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR code did not open a real report with my batch number, or the price was back at $29.99 with no first-box deal, I would skip it.
